job.title: Cropping Operator
job.description:
Marnoo, Wimmera, VIC

  • Senior role with a high degree of responsibility
  • 3,400 ha family-owned farming business
  • 2027 commencement

Our client operates a mixed enterprise business based near Marnoo Victoria. Running across 3,400Ha, this family operation now seeks an experienced Cropping Operator to join the team and lead the day to day cropping business.

Reporting directly to the Owner, this hands on role is responsible for the day to day operations of the cropping program. You will be part of a team and be involved with the planning, decision making, agronomic input, and accountability for results.

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys ownership of their work, values collaboration, and wants to contribute meaningfully to a progressive farming operation. The business values and will provide career development within a supportive, inclusive working environment where you are treated as part of the team. In short, if you demonstrate you are capable of more responsibility, it is likely to be given.

To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate:

  • Experience in a similar role, or have a career history showing this is the next logical step
  • Strong understanding of dryland cropping, pasture systems, and their link to livestock performance
  • Sound mechanical aptitude and experience with modern farm machinery
  • Experience in working in a team, with the confidence to delegate well, and step up to help others
  • A current ChemCert Certificate (or willingness to obtain)
  • Sheep experience (highly regarded) but not necessary
  • A proactive attitude and mindset, adaptability and flexibility, and a genuine desire to strive for excellence

In addition to competitive salary package, the successful candidate will be offered a comfortable, recently renovated four-bedroom family home, close to schools and local amenities.

The ideal candidate will commence in early 2027, but is negotiable with the right person.

To apply, send your resume to Meridian Agriculture on jobs@meridian-ag.com.au
job.salary: Salary negotiable for the right person
